questions.enonce_markdown: Draw a large labelled diagram of the longitudinal section through the mammalian heart, showing the direction of blood flow. *(13 marks)*
Describe the functions of the major components of blood. *(7 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
| Component | Function |
|---|---|
| **Plasma** (liquid, about 55 %) | transports **dissolved food** (glucose, amino acids), **carbon dioxide** (as hydrogencarbonate), **urea**, **hormones** and heat around the body; it also carries antibodies and blood proteins |
| **Red blood cells (erythrocytes)** | transport **oxygen** from the lungs to the tissues, as **oxyhaemoglobin** (they contain haemoglobin and have no nucleus, with a biconcave shape for a large surface area) |
| **White blood cells (leucocytes)** | **defend** the body against disease: **phagocytes** engulf and digest bacteria (phagocytosis); **lymphocytes** produce **antibodies** and antitoxins |
| **Platelets (thrombocytes)** | help in **blood clotting** at a wound: they release substances that change fibrinogen to insoluble **fibrin**, forming a clot that stops bleeding and prevents entry of germs |
